probe.decision: Use exact C4-invariant all900 single-pair plus ALL2025 double-pairs in the self-C4 (0,0) transverse fibre, then increase field shell2->3. All other fibres retain every virtual single-pair channel. This is a changed nonlinear variational family, not full multipair closure; no mass/coupling/stiffness retuning.
